g.text: PK = USER#{sub} (read: list my Maps, authorize a write)
PK = MAP#{mapId} (ONE Query = open a Map: tiles only)
PK = CONTENT#{nodeId} (ONE Query = open a node)
GSI1 (sparse): GSI1PK = MAP#PUBLIC (gallery: newest-published first, no Scan)
PK = MAP#ALL (constant key: ops list of all Maps, no Scan)
